desc: Upgrade your shooting experience with the Allen Company Baktrak Traverse Rifle Sling. Designed with BakTrak technology, this rifle sling prioritizes functionality, comfort, and durability. Its proprietary construction ensures the perfect balance of strength, weight, and comfort. The sling is fully adjustable and features integrated swivels for effortless attachment and detachment. The rubberized traction pad grips your shoulder securely, allowing you to carry your rifle comfortably for extended periods. Whether you're hunting or at the range, the Allen Company Baktrak Traverse Rifle Sling keeps your firearm within easy reach and ready for action. Trust in Allen Company, known for superior shooting accessories.
